returned_tweets.author: rileywestreel
returned_tweets.text: Monica Lam (Stanford Professor): AI writes shallow reports for one reason, you ask it ONE question. Our method asks dozens, like a journalist, and the same chatbot starts writing articles 25% better organized than top AI.

returned_tweets.author: VadimStrizheus
returned_tweets.text: Perplexity CEO on China catching up in AI: Whatever you did to not let them catch up didn't even matter. They ended up catching up anyway. What's more dangerous is they have the best open-source model. That was DeepSeek.

returned_tweets.author: fchollet
returned_tweets.text: The more you embrace AI, the more you need SaaS. This is not obvious to armchair market analysts who love disruption narratives, but it is obvious to people actually running companies.

returned_tweets.author: gregisenberg
returned_tweets.text: GLM 5.2 might be the ChatGPT moment for local AI. 1M token context window so it holds an entire codebase at once. Top open model on coding right now. MIT licensed.

returned_tweets.author: ihtesham2005
returned_tweets.text: Chamath fed Dario Amodei's own essays into Claude and asked for a psychological profile. The model identified a pattern. Dario distrusts other labs. He distrusts authoritarian states.

returned_tweets.author: JafarNajafov
returned_tweets.text: Adobe Acrobat is cooked. Someone built a free, open-source PDF editor that runs entirely on your own machine and never uploads a single file. It's called Stirling-PDF.

returned_tweets.author: VaibhavSisinty
returned_tweets.text: Google just mass-confirmed what the smartest Claude Code users figured out months ago. The best way to give AI a memory is a folder of markdown files. Google Cloud published it as an official open spec.

returned_tweets.author: LuizaJarovsky
returned_tweets.text: 42 state attorneys general are investigating OpenAI over alleged harmful practices. The tide has totally changed. Even the authorities have had enough.

returned_tweets.author: kyronis_talks
returned_tweets.text: Anthropic CEO: If my revenue is not 1 trillion, even 800 billion, there's no force on earth that could stop me from going bankrupt. In a 3-hour podcast, Dario Amodei does the math on his own bankruptcy. Revenue 10x a year.

returned_tweets.author: samiramanabi
returned_tweets.text: The talent density at Google is extremely high. That leads to incredible internal competition for resources but also means there is inherent resiliency. That being said, there is just one Noam Shazeer.

returned_tweets.author: DavidSacks
returned_tweets.text: Claude psychoanalyzing Dario is the AI slop I didn't know I needed.

returned_tweets.author: cyrilXBT
returned_tweets.text: GLM 5.2 just landed within 1% of Opus 4.8 on the hardest agentic coding benchmarks. At roughly a sixth of the price.

returned_tweets.author: r0ck3t23
returned_tweets.text: Sundar Pichai deployed 180 billion into AI. We probably have scaled our CapEx from 30 billion to approximately 180 billion.
